name: designlang-tokens
tagline_zh: 自己配的灰和圆角总差一口气，跟 cal.com 官方站放一起就露馅。这里把它的色板、间距刻度、字阶都抽成了令牌。
tagline_en: Your hand-picked grays and radii never quite match cal.com. This ships its extracted color, spacing, and type.
desc_en: Use when styling UI for cal.com — references the extracted design system tokens instead of inventing colors, spacing, or typography.
why_zh: 令牌来自对 cal.com 实际样式的抽取，不是照感觉编的一套近似值，所以改出来的界面能和原站对齐。
why_en: Tokens are extracted from cal.com's actual styles, not eyeballed approximations, so what you build lines up with the real site.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 cal.com 这一套设计系统，做别的品牌或自建视觉体系时它给不了参考；令牌是抽取快照。
limit_en: Covers only cal.com's design system; useless for other brands. Tokens are a snapshot — upstream redesigns won't sync automatically.
title_en: cal.com UI styling that pulls from its real design tokens
